caveats: These are requirements/specification cases, not observed pass/fail results.
Exact request examples are schema/routing probes. Holdout paraphrases should be written independently of source candidate wording before implementation.
Existing baseline failures must be measured before integration; this plan does not assume the broad suite currently passes.
A revised discovery surface needs a new hash and fresh relevant evidence; old pixels do not qualify new data.

metrics.term_fixture_reach: intended sense resolved with owner and variant
metrics.candidate_exposure: record actual ID and absence explicitly
metrics.adoption: record actual selected ID and composed relation; not required in every optional request
metrics.pixel_success: all required gates per arm, no averaging of failed arms
